changes_made.explanation: Added Graph Prediction as a second NLG task, removed redundant 'Action Generation' task, added Worldformer model, removed COMET filter (not an NLG model but a filter)
Normalized 'EM' to 'Exact Match' - these refer to the same metric (F1 and Exact Match are the two main metrics used)
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper - LLMs were used as generation models but not for evaluation

guideline: Human annotators classified errors in generated actions into three types: Object Localization and Inference errors, Object Affordance errors, and Insufficient Interaction Coverage errors. Analysis was performed on 50 randomly sampled examples from the validation set.

changes_made.explanation: Normalized criteria to base forms without 'errors' suffix, consolidated redundant entries

overall_notes: This paper focuses on NLG for text-based games, specifically generating valid text commands and predicting graph changes. The evaluation is comprehensive with both automatic metrics (F1, Exact Match) and human evaluation analyzing specific error types. The paper does NOT use LLMs as judges/evaluators - LLMs are used as generation models but not for assessment.
